source: ECOSORN project leaflet, "សណ្តែកសៀង (ពូជក្នុងស្រុក)" [Soybean (local varieties)], 2-page farmer extension leaflet
text:
This short ECOSORN-project farmer leaflet on soybean (សណ្តែកសៀង, Glycine max), focused on locally-adapted varieties, opens with land preparation: the field should be ploughed and harrowed to produce a fine, well-drained seedbed before sowing, since soybean is sensitive to waterlogging at germination.

The leaflet is a compact 2-page/4-panel farmer extension sheet, so land-preparation guidance is brief and is meant to be read alongside the variety-selection, planting, fertilizer, and harvest panels that follow on the same sheet.
